season_context.local_season_notes: Riyadh Fashion Week was due on 15 to 20 October 2026 but was postponed to 2027, and other major events were deferred as well. Founding Day falls in late February and Ramadan 2027 is expected from about 8 February, so heritage dress, abayas and Eid occasionwear dominate the November to March calendar.

sources.title: Riyadh Fashion Week postponed to next year (The National)
Saudi Founding Day brings heritage to life (KFUPM)

trends.name: Riyadh Fashion Week postponed
trends.summary: The fourth Riyadh Fashion Week, planned for 15 to 20 October 2026, was postponed a day before opening. Organisers have not announced new dates or a lineup.

trends.name: Global houses localise in KSA
trends.summary: Luxury brands are moving from serving Saudi clients remotely to holding fittings in Riyadh and Jeddah. Missoni, Eleventy, Corneliani and ISAIA have opened first stores, joining Louis Vuitton, Dior and Celine.

trends.name: Modest cuts in luxury collections
trends.summary: Saudi luxury shoppers are steering houses toward modest silhouettes, rich embroidery and Arab-influenced design. Craft, provenance and exclusivity increasingly outrank logos.

trends.name: Couture beyond weddings
trends.summary: Saudi couture spending is spreading from weddings to galas, red carpets, eveningwear and polished daywear. Georges Hobeika reports more fittings in Riyadh and Jeddah.

trends.name: Craftsmanship over logos
trends.summary: Saudi consumers are described as better informed and more selective, able to tell couture from ready-to-wear. Local labels are gaining demand, though shoppers still resist luxury pricing for them.

trends.name: Saudi streetwear goes global
trends.summary: Riyadh label 1886 sells hoodies, joggers, tees and dresses shaped by Saudi youth, music and art culture. It is stocked at Selfridges' Saudi pop-up after a Galeries Lafayette Paris run.

trends.name: Regional heritage as a design brief
trends.summary: Graduates at Riyadh's Arts and Skills Institute built collections from Najdi desert landscapes, Jazan's khawlani coffee harvest and Hejazi architecture, reflecting design students' interest in regional identity.

trends.name: 1980s power shoulders
trends.summary: One Saudi graduate reworked her mother's 1980s wedding dress with bold colour and broad shoulders, an early sign of local interest in eighties-era proportions.

trends.name: South Asian and Hejazi modesty fusion
trends.summary: A Riyadh graduate collection merged Pakistani, Najdi and Hejazi dress codes, including burqa-derived face pieces, framing modesty as common ground between South Asian and Gulf cultures.

trends.name: Lavender and burgundy at the Saudi Cup
trends.summary: At the February 2026 Saudi Cup, lavender stood out, from a Najdi-style women's outfit to men's thobes, with burgundy thobes appearing alongside.

trends.name: Regional dress at society events
trends.summary: Women at the 2026 Saudi Cup wore traditional garments from across the Kingdom, including Najdi styles, paired with race-day headwear.

trends.name: Patterned thobes and Saudi embroidery
trends.summary: Menswear at the 2026 Saudi Cup included patterned thobes and Saudi-inspired embroidery, showing a gradual move away from plain white for occasions.

trends.name: Saudi 100 Brands runways
trends.summary: The Fashion Commission's Saudi 100 Brands staged runways at the Saudi Cup for THEXO, Enays, Sulitude, MD29, Adara By Fa and Hajruss, plus a jewellery and accessories exhibition.

trends.name: Coloured abaya dresses
trends.summary: Gulf influencers wore abaya dresses in red, peach, mustard, turquoise and emerald for Ramadan 2026, with embroidery, braided trims and crystal belts replacing plain black.

trends.name: Abaya with jeans
trends.summary: Across the Gulf, open abayas styled over straight or flared jeans with silk tops and metallic accessories became a daytime and suhoor look for Ramadan 2026.

trends.name: Gulf abayas on Paris modest runway
trends.summary: At Paris Modest Fashion Week in April 2026, Gulf labels such as Qatar's Hindami showed occasion and everyday abayas and jalabiyas, and Kuwait's Roqaia used sculptural turbans.

trends.name: Modest fashion week goes mainstream
trends.summary: Paris held its first Modest Fashion Week in April 2026. Labels showed fully covering silhouettes and tailored headscarf styling, such as a beret worn over a hijab.

trends.name: Ramadan 2027 from early February
trends.summary: Ramadan 2027 is projected to start around 8 February, with Eid al-Fitr around 9 or 10 March, depending on moon sighting. Modest and festive buying will peak from January.

trends.name: Riyadh Fashion Week 2027 return
trends.summary: Organisers say the fourth Riyadh Fashion Week will take place in 2027 and promise a larger edition, though dates and designers have not been announced.

trends.name: GCC luxury toward $15bn by 2027
trends.summary: Chalhoub expects GCC personal luxury to reach about $15 billion by 2027. Saudi Arabia is the largest and fastest-growing jewellery market in the region and leads fragrance growth.

trends.name: Arabic lettering and animal prints
trends.summary: HINDAMME's Hejaz collection at Riyadh Fashion Week 2025 ran Arabic script across mostly monochrome looks, with leopard and zebra-print hats and scarves.

trends.name: Silk, leather and metallics
trends.summary: The same HINDAMME show mixed silk shirts, knits, a floor-length unisex leather coat, boxy metallic jackets and an embroidered mesh veil referencing Jeddah's Red Sea coast.

trends.name: Sadu and Al-Qatt Al-Asiri motifs
trends.summary: Saudi designers reworked Sadu weaving geometry, Asiri Al-Qatt painting and precise Najdi embroidery into minimal and couture garments during the Kingdom's 2025 Year of Handicrafts.

trends.name: Sculptural couture corsetry
trends.summary: Saudi-led Ashi Studio's couture used cinched corsets, fishtails, high slits and exaggerated shoulders in black, ivory and champagne, a reference point for Saudi eveningwear.

trends.name: 3D printing meets handcraft
trends.summary: A Saudi handcraft-to-couture competition showed 3D-printed metal with camel leather alongside natural dyeing and hand embroidery, a sign of tech-craft hybrid techniques.

trends.name: Founding Day heritage dress
trends.summary: Saudi personalities marked Founding Day in green jalabiyas, an embroidered Hijazi darfat al bab, maroon regional dress, and a bisht over thobe for men.

trends.name: Streetwear day at Riyadh Fashion Week
trends.summary: The 2025 Riyadh Fashion Week gave a full day to local labels such as 1886, Cargo and Eleven, framing streetwear as part of a confident new Saudi fashion identity.
